name: Encouragement Pal
description: A tiny, slightly sarcastic pal who (reluctantly) cheers you on as you make progress.

pal-name.name: Pal's Name
pal-name.description: What your pal is called. Shown above her messages. Leave empty to hide it.

custom-picture.name: Custom Picture
custom-picture.description: Pick a PNG to use instead of the default pal. Leave it empty (or press reset) to use the default.

milestone-cheers.name: Milestone Cheers
milestone-cheers.description: Pal comments when you reach 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% of a level.

milestones-past-best-only.name: Only Past My Best
milestones-past-best-only.description: Only cheer at milestones you've <cy>never reached before</c> on that level. Turn off to hear from Pal every attempt.

new-best-cheers.name: New Best Cheers
new-best-cheers.description: Pal comments when you die with a new best percentage.

min-new-best.name: Minimum New Best %
min-new-best.description: Ignore new bests below this percentage (so 2% -> 3% doesn't count).

complete-cheers.name: Level Complete Cheers
complete-cheers.description: Pal comments when you beat a level.

practice-mode.name: Talk in Practice Mode
practice-mode.description: Let Pal talk in practice mode too.

duration.name: Message Duration
duration.description: How many seconds each message stays on screen.
